title: The all-skipped summary says "reported above" and printed before the lines it counts
foundBy: session agent, following README.md and INSTALL.md as a first-time reader

evidence.verified: TestAllSkippedSummaryFollowsTheLinesItCounts normalizes a directory of two unparseable files and asserts the two skip lines come first. Against the previous code it fails, printing the summary at index 0.

details:
A directory whose files hold no conversation prints, on stderr, in this order:

```
0 sessions normalized (1 file(s) skipped, reported above)
skipping zero-events/notasession.json: normalized to zero events (adapter: claude-code) — not a session file
```

The summary refers to lines that follow it. `internal/normalizer/tree.go` appended the summary to the diagnostics and then sorted the slice, and "0" sorts before "skipping".
